# Perspectives

The **same measured outcomes** apply to all three perspectives. Do not invent arbitrary weighted maturity or readiness scores.

| Perspective | Central question | Essential additional checks |
|---|---|---|
| Conventional | Can this system deliver useful changes quickly and reliably? | Effective tests, release recovery, security, operational controls |
| AI-assisted | Can people use AI without weakening those outcomes and safeguards? | Approved context/tools, human accountability, independent tests and non-bypassable CI/security checks |
| AI-driven | Can bounded agents safely deliver under independent oversight? | Scoped permissions, sandboxes, injection resistance, independent oracles, no self-approval, traceable promotion, rollback and telemetry |

Report **measured outcomes** once, then relevant **verified / concerning / unknown / N/A** assurance differences by perspective. No AI adoption is required for excellent conventional results; hypothetical AI gains are not measurements.
